hotels.name: Stone Town View Hotel
hotels.source: STO Agreement 2026-2027 (Bed & Breakfast, net rates, USD)

policy.earlyCheckInLateCheckOut: 50% of nightly rate, subject to availability
policy.cancellation: More than 30 days: full refund. 30-15 days: 50% fee. Less than 15 days or no-show: 100% fee
policy.payment: 25% deposit within 7 days of confirmation; 75% balance 14 days before arrival

hotels.propertyFacts: 23 rooms, all overlooking Zanzibar City. The rooftop restaurant Verde is a bistro and juice bar serving Mediterranean and international cuisine with an Indian Ocean panorama, and breakfast is served on the sun terrace. Free Wi-Fi, family rooms, 24-hour front desk, room service, daily housekeeping, parking on site, bike rental and car hire. There is no swimming pool.
hotels.viewFacts: All 23 rooms overlook Zanzibar City. The rooftop restaurant and sun terrace give the ocean panorama.
hotels.distanceFacts: 5.1 mi (about 8 km) from Abeid Amani Karume International Airport. 8 minutes' walk from Darajani Market and a few steps from the Zanzibar Ferry Terminal.

hotels.name: The Island Stonetown
hotels.source: STO Agreement 2026-2027 (Bed & Breakfast, net rates per room, USD)

policy.earlyCheckInLateCheckOut: 50% of nightly rate, subject to availability
policy.cancellation: More than 30 days: full refund. 30-15 days: 50% fee. Less than 15 days or no-show: 100% fee
policy.payment: 25% deposit within 7 days of confirmation; 75% balance 14 days before arrival

hotels.propertyFacts: Boutique hotel with a rooftop terrace restaurant, a coffee shop, a spa centre with full body, head, foot and back massage, BBQ facilities, a children's buffet, free Wi-Fi, 24-hour reception and security, luggage storage, currency exchange, room service, housekeeping, laundry, car hire and tour and ticket assistance. There is no swimming pool.
hotels.viewFacts: Rooms have city views over the Stone Town rooftops. There are no sea or ocean view rooms - the hotel stands 350 m inland from Stone Town Beach.
hotels.distanceFacts: About 5 km (5-7 minutes by road) from Abeid Amani Karume International Airport. 7 minutes' walk from Darajani Market, 11 minutes' walk to the Old Fort and a 6-minute walk to Stone Town Beach.

hotels.name: Mkeka Spice Lodge
hotels.source: Owner-confirmed rates (breakfast included, USD per room per night)
hotels.propertyFacts: Lodge of thatched-roof bungalows with a year-round outdoor swimming pool, a restaurant serving African cuisine, a bar and outdoor lounge with a fireplace, an outdoor breakfast area, a rooftop terrace, a spa with massage, free Wi-Fi, free private parking and a paid airport shuttle. Rooms are Triple Rooms with a full bed and a queen bed, plus Family Rooms, each with a private bathroom, terrace or balcony and garden or pool views.
hotels.viewFacts: Rooms have garden or pool views from the terrace or balcony. The pool and the Indian Ocean are visible from the lodge.
hotels.distanceFacts: About 1 hour by road from Abeid Amani Karume International Airport. A 2-minute walk to Paje Beach.

hotels.name: Le Paradis Boutique Hotel Zanzibar
hotels.source: Official website room rates (leparadiszanzibar.com). Public display rate = 20% below the published online rate.

policy.ratePlans: Flexible (7-day cancellation), non-refundable, and 2-night-minimum shoulder-season saver plans available; breakfast included

hotels.propertyFacts: Boutique hotel a one-minute walk from the Indian Ocean shore at Jambiani and a short walk from lively Paje. Three room types: Standard Garden Room, Superior Garden Room and Executive Seaside View Room. Pool with an ocean outlook, fine-dining restaurant, bar, spa, high-ceilinged lounge with local art and a tropical courtyard.
hotels.viewFacts: The Executive Seaside View Room faces the ocean; the garden rooms look over the gardens and village.
hotels.distanceFacts: About 1 hour by road from Abeid Amani Karume International Airport.

hotels.name: The One Resort Zanzibar
hotels.source: Official rack rate sheet 01.05.2026-30.04.2027 (theonezanzibar.com). Public display rate = 15% below published rack.

policy.minStay: Minimum 2 nights in all seasons; 4 nights in Festive Season (21 Dec – 07 Jan)
policy.childPolicy: Half Board: kids under 2 free; each additional person +$60. All Inclusive: kids under 4 free, ages 4-16 +$50, 17+ +$75
policy.singleOccupancy: Single occupancy: -$15 in Half Board, -$35 in All Inclusive
policy.paymentPolicy: Standard: full payment 30 days before arrival. Festive Season: full payment after reservation.
policy.cancellationPolicy: Standard: 25% cancellation fee 30-15 days prior, 50% at 14-7 days, 100% within 7 days or no-show. Festive Season: non-refundable.
policy.festiveSupplement: Christmas Eve (24 Dec) +$50 per adult; New Year's Eve (31 Dec) +$70 per adult; children 4-11.99 at 50% of adult rate, under 4 complimentary
policy.boardIncludes: Half Board: buffet breakfast and dinner (breakfast only on departure day). All Inclusive: breakfast, lunch and dinner, welcome drink, bottled water daily, housekeeping and turndown
policy.lateCheckOutFee: USD 40 until 18:00; USD 120 until 23:00 (includes room, lunch, dinner and drinks)

hotels.propertyFacts: 36 rooms across four types: Lychee Deluxe Double (17 rooms, 2 pax), Mango Deluxe Double/Twin (13 rooms, 2-3 pax), Papaya Junior Suite (4 rooms, 2-4 pax) and Tiki Deluxe Suite (2 rooms, 2-5 pax). Every room has a terrace or balcony, air conditioning, a ceiling fan and a mosquito net. Private beach, the biggest swimming pool on Zanzibar's east coast with a Jacuzzi, a pool bar, the Meza gourmet restaurant, a wellness spa, a water sports centre and daily and evening activities.
hotels.viewFacts: Rooms face the ocean, the swimming pool or the internal garden depending on location. Every room has a terrace or balcony.
hotels.distanceFacts: About 1 hour by road from Abeid Amani Karume International Airport (ZNZ).
